ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by an approximately 80% high-intensity light gray interior surface area bounded by a 20% low-intensity dark gray to black perimeter margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Light gray interior field framed by a dark perimeter band. Single focal circular dark pixel cluster in the upper-left lobe quadrant. Two vertical dark linear streaks originating at the trailing edge and extending toward the fluke center on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge; serrations are most pronounced and jagged at the distal tips, becoming smaller and more uniform toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curves extending from the median notch to the distal tips, resulting in an upward-curving 'winged' profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single distinct circular dark pixel cluster located on the interior surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) positioned symmetrically, one on each lobe, extending from the trailing edge inward.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, jagged structural margins at the distal tips of both lobes, suggesting significant wear or previous physical trauma.
